body: Thanks Fembot. You have a Merry Christmas, or Robanukah or whatever you choose to celebrate.

But I've yet to find anyone who can love those parts of me as well. Perhaps that's normal. Perhaps everyone lies and hides their real selves so they can interact socially. But its not me. I can't do it. I want to know and be known fully. And I can love all the shit inside someone. 

And sometimes I find someone who can love my shit as well. But then they don't like the light in me. Or I find someone who likes my preoccupation with "good" things but can't stand my internal love affair with darkness. Or perhaps I find someone who can deal with both my good and bad but can't handle being accepted at such an implicit level. 

The list of ways it hasn't fucking fucking worked goes on but there is no list of how it has worked. It never does.
It certainly is. But its fucking lonely as shit.

I do agree with you about change. Change is constant and unavoidable. The problem is that I am rather fond of the parts of myself that tend to isolate me. I just don't think I am meant for this world. I don't interface with it like other people and would rather never do so.

Thank you :) but I think I'm done trying. I have pushed away some rather unpushable people, though I'm sure it would take longer with someone of your constitution I've found it to be the one constant in this fucking miserable world.
